summary: A Yes vote enacts a 1% transactions and use (sales) tax in the City of Arvin for general city services.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a new 1% local sales tax to fund general city services, including public safety, roads, parks, and youth and senior services.
tax.quote: On November 3, 2026, City of Arvin voters will vote on a proposed one-percent local transactions and use tax, commonly called a local sales tax. If approved, the measure would add one cent to each taxable dollar spent in Arvin and is estimated to generate approximately $2.35 million annually for general City services.

tax.text: A No vote would block Arvin's proposed 1% sales tax from taking effect.
tax.quote: A "no" vote would prevent the proposed tax from taking effect. It would not eliminate an existing Arvin tax.
